comparison: Causal reverse control vs Rung 3a law4-sgd-g-equil-d (5/13 PASS) and Rung 3b law4-sgd-g-secant-equil-d (9/15 PASS), against unified-v11 (16/16 PASS).
conclusion: Rung 4 (law4_equil_g_sgd_d: causal reverse control — exact unified_v11_equil on G & prior, pure unnormalized SGD on D with 0 D normalization and 0 D secant) scores 12/16 executed PASS (3 numerical FAIL, 1 NaN-explosion INCOMPLETE via FloatingPointError, 0 prereq-gated) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Proves an extraordinary causal G-vs-D asymmetry law reversing conventional intuition: Equil-G + SGD-D (12/16) outperforms SGD-G + Equil-D (5/13) by +7 tasks and even SGD-G+secant + Equil-D (9/15) by +3 tasks! Because Law 2 Born-Infeld regularization already keeps D's potential smooth and 1-Lipschitz on balanced architectures, pure SGD on D passes grid100 (prec=0.9919, ctr=0.1204), five_word_joint_smoke (5/5, tv=0.0189, recon=1), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0=0.2596), zero_tanh_rail_escape (mae=0.0006), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.6869), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), ring16 (0.9873), vector_unequal_mass/width (0.9973), and nash_overpowered_generator (16/16 hq=0.9719). Crucially, nash_overpowered_critic_ring16 (620x D>>G) immediately explodes to NaN (FloatingPointError in 5.4s), establishing an exact 2x2 causal double dissociation with Rung 3a (where overpowered_critic PASSED 0.9783 and overpowered_generator collapsed to 8/16). Minor remaining misses under starved SGD-D: grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.9722, ctr=0.6118), gaussian1d_stability (ks=0.0201), t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (4/4 hq=0.9219).
